title: My Graduation Day
paragraphs: Today is my graduation day.
I wake up at six.
I am happy, but I am nervous too.
I put on my new suit and look in the mirror.
I smile.
My mother makes breakfast, but I can't eat.
My sister laughs at me.
My father wears his old wedding suit.
It is a little small now!
We take a taxi to the university.
The traffic is terrible.
I check the time again and again.
At the ceremony, I wait for my name.
My hands are cold.
Then I hear it: "Adam Fares!"
I walk to the stage and take my certificate.
My family claps and cheers.
I feel proud.
In the evening, we celebrate at a restaurant.
My uncle asks me, "Where are you working now?"
I don't have an answer.
At night, I can't sleep.
I open my laptop and search for jobs.
Every job wants good English.
So I make a decision: I will practice English every day.

phrases.ex: I feel proud of my son.

questions.a: He puts on his new suit and looks in the mirror.

questions.a: He wears his old wedding suit, and it is a little small.

Why can't Adam sleep at night?
questions.a: Because he doesn't have a job, and every job wants good English.
He decides to practice English every day.

yourTurn.prompt: Tell me about an important day in your life. Use these phrases: wake up, put on, feel proud, make a decision.
yourTurn.example: My wedding day was very important. I woke up early. I put on my new suit and looked in the mirror. I felt nervous, but I also felt proud. That day, I made a decision: to be a good husband.

notice.title: He / she / it + -s
fromStory: I wake up at six. → Adam wakes up at six.
I feel proud. → He feels proud.
